clue.text: Newspaper reported a bloomer

indicators.note: reported here means said out loud, so the newspaper's name is heard rather than seen

parts.note: the Daily (Mail, Telegraph...) is a common shorthand for a newspaper

explanation.surface: A paper has printed an embarrassing blunder, a howler in its own pages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reported' turns DAILY into its sound-alike, followed by 'a'. A 'bloomer' is both a blunder and something that blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant that flowers is jokingly a bloomer, and this is a familiar garden flower.

clue.text: Island off Scotland is English? Heavens above!

indicators.note: in a down entry, above means the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: the heavens are the sky

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry at the suggestion that a Scottish island is English.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heavens above!' reads as an exclamation; it actually places SKY over E in the down light.
explanation.definitionFit: This Inner Hebrides island lies off the west coast of Scotland.

clue.text: Acrimoniously leave fat, grasping old politician

indicators.note: grasping means holding something within, so one piece wraps around the others

parts.note: stout means fat
MP, Member of Parliament, is a politician

explanation.surface: Someone storms off in anger, while a portly veteran politician is also in the scene.
explanation.definitionFit: To storm off by stamping one's feet in anger is to leave acrimoniously.

clue.text: Possible explanation for itchier skin's oddly dismissed

indicators.note: the odd-placed letters are thrown out, leaving only the even ones

explanation.surface: A dermatologist's theory about itchy skin has been strangely rejected.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing the 1st, 3rd, 5th... letters of 'itchier skin's' leaves T H E S I S.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposition put forward to be tested is a possible explanation of something.

clue.text: Sick setter, pissed on rum, died

parts.note: the setter refers to themself as I

indicators.note: rum here is the adjective meaning odd, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for died in genealogies

explanation.surface: The compiler confesses to being ill after drinking too much rum and dying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rum' looks like the drink but is the adjective 'strange', signalling an anagram of PISSED ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unwell or slightly ill is a polite synonym for sick.

clue.text: Ruined European in Great Britain urged to move

indicators.note: letters made to move are shuffled into a new order

explanation.surface: A European living in Britain, urged to leave, finds his life ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: A British slang word for broken or wrecked, so it means ruined.

clue.text: Rugby player's jersey is possible reason for 21

parts.note: a back is a rugby player in the rear positions; 's adds S
a jersey is a top

explanation.surface: A rugby player's shirt might be why there's no deal.
explanation.walkthrough: The Irish border insurance clause in the 2019 Brexit withdrawal agreement was a main reason Parliament rejected the deal.
explanation.definitionFit: This Irish border guarantee was the sticking point that made leaving without agreement possible.

clue.text: Timely reminder

definitions.meaning: punctual, done at the right time
a cue given to an actor who forgets a line

explanation.surface: A reminder that arrives at just the right moment.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both punctual as an adjective and a cue to jog memory as a noun.

clue.text: Respect refusal to be constrained by time

indicators.note: being constrained by something means being held inside it

parts.note: an hour is a measure of time
no is a refusal

explanation.surface: A call to respect someone's refusal to be bound by time limits.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold someone in high esteem, to respect them, is a synonymous verb.

clue.text: Sporting purple sabots as a symbol of 'independence'

indicators.note: sporting can mean wearing or displaying, but here it signals the letters playing about into a new order

explanation.surface: Wearing purple clogs as a badge of independence.
explanation.walkthrough: Brexiteers hailed the return of the old-coloured travel document as a symbol of regained independence.
explanation.definitionFit: Leavers celebrated the return of the old dark-coloured travel document as a token of national sovereignty.

clue.text: Doctors pinning down GI's bizarre psychological symptoms

indicators.note: pinning holds something inside, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: MO, medical officer, is a doctor; plural MOS

indicators.note: bizarre signals the letters arranged oddly

explanation.surface: Medics restraining an American soldier whose strange behaviour suggests psychological trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Sudden changes of temperament are symptoms of psychological conditions.

clue.text: Japanese electronics company introduces new gaming site

indicators.note: a company introducing something brings it inside itself

parts.note: Casio is a Japanese maker of watches and calculators

explanation.surface: A Japanese electronics firm launches a new online gaming platform.
explanation.definitionFit: A place where people gamble is a venue for gaming.

clue.text: Amount one raised covering 8 musical compositions

indicators.note: covering means wrapping around the other piece
in a down entry, raised means read upwards, i.e. backwards

parts.note: a sum is an amount
I is the Roman numeral one
the answer to 8 down

explanation.surface: Mechanics only on the surface: an amount lifted to cover another clue's answer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' gives IMUS, read upward in this down light; 'covering' wraps it around the answer to 8.
explanation.definitionFit: Short free-form instrumental pieces, as by Schubert or Chopin, are musical compositions.

clue.text: See 10
Carbon copy keeps returning to author

parts.note: C is the chemical symbol for carbon

indicators.note: keeps means holds within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to ape is to copy

indicators.note: returning means the word to is read backwards

explanation.surface: A carbon copy keeps being sent back to the writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Truman Capote was the American writer of In Cold Blood.

clue.text: Game plan for 2019

definitions.meaning: the British name for the board game Americans call checkers
Theresa May's 2018 Brexit proposal, named after the PM's country residence

explanation.surface: A strategy for the year 2019.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both the board game draughts and the Brexit plan agreed at the Prime Minister's country house.

clue.text: On friendly terms with Germany? Shut up!

parts.note: close means intimate, on friendly terms
D is the international vehicle code for Germany (Deutschland)

explanation.surface: Someone asked if they're friendly with Germany snaps back to be quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: Shut up means sealed or locked, the same sense as a shop being not open.

clue.text: Journal contains old line about knight

indicators.note: contains means holds the other piece within it

parts.note: The Lancet is a British medical journal

indicators.note: about here signals a turnaround of the pieces it governs

explanation.surface: A periodical carries an old line of text about a knight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns O+L into LO, which goes inside LANCET.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Lancelot was a knight of King Arthur's Round Table.

clue.text: Minister to Yankee in Lisbon, say

parts.note: to minister to someone is to attend to or treat them
Yankee is Y in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A government minister attends to an American in Portugal's capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lisbon' looks like a city but stands for the 2007 EU agreement whose Article 50 governed Brexit.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lisbon agreement is an example of a formal international pact between states.

clue.text: Typical Independent reader (some say) more excited by article about revolutionary

indicators.note: excited letters are stirred up into a new order

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: revolutionary means turning round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A self-mocking picture of the paper's reader, more worked up by a piece on a revolutionary.
explanation.definitionFit: Leave-backers' slang for a Remainer who keeps complaining about Brexit, as Independent readers were stereotyped.

clue.text: Absolutely not accepting Rutherford's original model

indicators.note: accepting means taking something in, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: no way is an emphatic refusal

indicators.note: original means the first letter

explanation.surface: A flat rejection of the physicist's original atomic model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rutherford's original model' suggests the atom; the definition is the Norwegian EEA arrangement mooted for post-Brexit Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scandinavian country's EEA relationship with the EU was a proposed template for Britain after Brexit.

clue.text: Retired L.A. crime boss accepts English alternative to 15D

indicators.note: accepts means takes in, so one piece goes inside the other
retired means drawn back, so the letters are read backwards

parts.note: a don is a Mafia boss

explanation.surface: A retired Los Angeles gangster takes on an English alternative to the game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired' gives NODAL by reversal; 'accepts' sets the E inside it. '15D' points to the Chequers Brexit plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaving the EU without a withdrawal agreement was the alternative to the Chequers plan.

clue.text: Ludicrous sailor's uniform gets ridiculed heartlessly

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor; 's adds S
Uniform is U in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: heartlessly means with all the middle letters removed

explanation.surface: A sailor's ludicrous uniform gets mocked without mercy.
explanation.definitionFit: Absurd and ludicrous are synonyms for ridiculous.

clue.text: Sounds like sheepshagger's clothing has a household name

indicators.note: sounds like says the words are heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a tupper is a ram (it tups ewes), and its clothing is its wear

explanation.surface: A crude joke about what a ram wears turning out to be a famous brand.
explanation.definitionFit: The plastic food-container brand is so familiar it is a byword in kitchens.

clue.text: Arch European backing Central Bank's U-turn

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the letters are read in reverse
central means the letters are taken from inside the words

explanation.surface: A staunch pro-European supports the central bank's change of policy.
explanation.walkthrough: Inside 'Bank's U-turn' lie KSUT; 'backing' reverses them.
explanation.definitionFit: Donald Tusk, President of the European Council during Brexit, was an arch-supporter of the EU.

clue.text: Way to get around penniless down-and-out

indicators.note: penniless means without P, the abbreviation for penny

parts.note: a tramp is a down-and-out

explanation.surface: A homeless person with no money needs a way to get around.
explanation.definitionFit: A streetcar is a means of transport, a way to travel about a city.

clue.text: Unionist intervening in 24D gets a shock

indicators.note: intervening in means coming between, so placed inside

parts.note: the answer to 24 down

explanation.surface: A Unionist intervening on a streetcar gets a shock.
explanation.definitionFit: A severe emotional shock or injury is a synonym.

clue.text: Landowners from Spain renovated manor within two years

indicators.note: within means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: Y is the abbreviation for year, twice
E is the international vehicle code for Spain (España)

indicators.note: renovated means remade, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Landowners from Spain renovated a manor house over two years.
explanation.definitionFit: Small freeholders who farm their own land collectively form this class.
